newsitem.title: GHANA: Ghana Stock index rises in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Ghana Stock index rises in thin trade.

text.p: The Ghana Stock Exchange share index rose on Friday in thin trade, continuing a pattern that has dominated the week.
The All-Share Index gained 2.95 points to close at 385.80.
Total market capitalisation rose to 3,299.20 billion cedis from 3,295.05 billion cedis on Wednesday. Offers exceeded bids by 917,580 shares to 103,470.
Just 32,880 shares were traded down on Wednesday's moderate 114,030 shares. All 13,500 Mobil Oil Ghana Ltd shares offered were traded raising the price 700 cedis to 7,000 cedis.

The exchange's second biggest equity, Ghana Commercial Bank, continued its firm run, rising eight cedis to 750. Fan Milk Ltd rose three cedis to 383. Unilever fell one cedi to 799. -- Abidjan Newsroom +225 21 90 90
